title: Without the Beloved, decoration stays hollow
summary: Without the Beloved, decoration cannot cover a heart split by duality. Do not ask decoration to cover duality.
takeaway: Do not ask decoration to cover duality.
lifeApplication: Before fixing the outside, ask whether the heart is still split from the Beloved and already crumbling within.

source.shortMeaning: Without the Beloved, decoration cannot cover a heart split by duality.
source.lifeApplication: Before fixing the outside, ask whether the heart is still living in duality.
